_comment: Synthetic demo data for the IOS v2.1 personal Dashboard (Issue #242 Phase B). No real company, no real holdings -- every code/name below is fictional. Shape matches setup/schema/sheet-schema.json exactly (same tab and field names) and is used both by test/dashboard-logic.test.js and as the reference dataset a fresh installation can seed itself with. Field values are strings/numbers as they would appear read out of a Google Sheet -- dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD', datetimes as ISO 8601.
